messages:
sindhu: Heads-up — customer ACME reported a p99 jump on chat API around 2026-03-15 09:20 UTC, affects short sequences (<64 tokens). Metrics show spike coincident with last night's runtime compile flag push.

oliver: saw the alert. looks like SDPA fallback started being used for a subset of requests. p95 also nudged up ~35ms for small seqs.

jake: which compile flag? any PR/rollout id?

dmitri: it was the new -O2-vec attention heuristic and a kernel selection tweak (enable-sdpa-for-legacy-arch). rolled at 02:00 UTC. CI passed but perf tests were long-seq focused.

support-bot: customer-rep: "users see chat responses slow to 300-400ms p99 (was ~120ms). Impacting UX, some cancel/retry errors."

oliver: repro steps from ACME: curl our chat endpoint with model=redwood-chat-1, max_tokens=30, temp=0.2, send 3-4 short messages in thread. They attached a replay.

sindhu: can someone grab a flamegraph or kernel selection log for a repro? I want to see whether FlashAttention was used vs SDPA.

ci-bot: @dmitri deployed roll 2026-03-15T02:00Z flagged: enable-sdpa-for-legacy-arch=true, attention-opt-level=2.

oliver: quick check of logs: for many requests we see fallback to sdpa_kernel_v2 with high kernel_latency_ms in traces. Example trace snippet: 
```
kernel_select: flash_pref_score=0.18 -> selected=sdpa_kernel_v2
kernel_latency_ms: 0.210 (expected ~0.080)
kv_cache_miss: false
seq_len: 24
```

jake: that latency delta matches p99 increase. hypothesis: compile flag increased SDPA selection for short seqs on some GPUs and sdpa_kernel_v2 is slower on these micro-batches.

dmitri: possible cause: vectorized attention path under -O2-vec produced less efficient warp occupancy for seq<64 on Ampere64. Our kernel chooser uses a heuristic that favors sdpa when vectorized score > threshold; the compile change bumped that score.

oliver: mitigation options: 1) rollback compile flag (fast but broad), 2) force kernel override for chat model to prefer flashattn for seq<128, 3) hotpatch kernel chooser to adjust threshold for specific GPU types, 4) canary rollback for the flagged deploy.

sindhu: recommend immediate: pin kernel selection for chat routes to flashattn for 24h and open canary for a staged rollback of compile flag. Also ask ACME to run repro with our pinned header to confirm.

dmitri: I can push a hotfix to runtime that adds a per-model kernel-override config; will take ~45min to build/canary.

jake: add a temporary routing policy: route requests from high-traffic users to legacy kernel pool (flashattn), limit batch sizes to avoid SDPA path. Ops can do that now.

oliver: created a mitigation runbook check-list: 
- route override: model=redwood-chat-1 -> prefer=flashattn (ops change)
- canary rollback: deploy flag disable (dmitri) on 10% -> 50% -> 100% if metrics improve
- trace capture: enable detailed kernel logs for affected nodes for 2h
- alert change: suppress noisy p95 alerts for short windows to avoid paging

support-bot: informed ACME about our mitigation plan and asked for repro payload. They said they can reproduce, will test after we flip routing.

dmitri: starting build now. patch adds env KERNEL_OVERRIDE=model:flashattn:seq_threshold=128 and a gpu-type exception for Ampere64.

ci-bot: build queued (#4821). estimate 22m.

oliver: ops — please apply route change (prefer flashattn for redwood-chat-1) on pool-prod-1.

jake: applied route override to pool-prod-1 and pool-prod-2, verified kernel choices on a few test requests show flashattn selected.

sindhu: monitoring metrics — p99 for short-seq chat dropped from 380ms -> 140ms within 5m. p95 back near baseline. good.

support-bot: ACME confirms improved latency on their end.

dmitri: once patch finishes, we'll roll canary for compile flag disable. plan: 10% at 30m, 100% by 3h if no regressions.

oliver: postmortem pointers: test matrix missing short-seq performance on Ampere64 after vectorizing compile change. add perf tests for seq buckets <64, 64-256, >256. Also add kernel selection unit tests for heuristic thresholds.

sindhu: thanks all. I'll file follow-up: ticket runtime#987 (investigate vectorized compile impact & add tests) and ops#654 (route override runbook).
